page_title: ROM 2-0 FRO | AS Roma v Frosinone 01/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' That's it for today, Matteo Marchetti has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+9' Frosinone force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
90+7' A pass by Arijon Ibrahimovic (Frosinone) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The ball goes out of play and AS Roma will have a goal kick.
90+5' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) was close to scoring after he unleashed a powerful shot which went a whisker wide of the left post.
90+3' Matteo Marchetti blows the whistle, Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) is penalised for a foul.
90+1' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Paulo Dybala departs the field of play to be replaced by Sardar Azmoun (AS Roma).
90' There will be a minimum of 8 min. of added time.
90' Walid Cheddira (Frosinone) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball. The ball goes out of play and AS Roma will have a goal kick.
85' Here is a change. Enzo Barrenechea is going off and Eusebio Di Francesco gives the last tactical orders to Arijon Ibrahimovic (Frosinone).
85' Referee Matteo Marchetti signals that the goal stands after the VAR review and the AS Roma players have a reason to celebrate!
85' Eusebio Di Francesco prepares a substitution. Luca Mazzitelli is replaced by Mehdi Bourabia (Frosinone).
85' Here's the change. Lorenzo Pellegrini leaves the pitch and Houssem Aouar (AS Roma) comes on as a substitute.
85' Wait a minute! The referee has decided to review the goal using the VAR system.
83' 2 - 0 Paulo Dybala sends a cross in from the free kick. Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) wins the ball and smashes it low into the middle of the goal, increasing the score to 2:0.
82' It's like he was asking for a caution. Matias Soule (Frosinone) receives a yellow card.
81' Edoardo Bove (AS Roma) controls a great pass from Paulo Dybala on the edge of the box, steadies himself but his poor effort goes yards over the bar.
78' Rasmus Kristensen (AS Roma) rises above the defenders and places a towering header towards the right post, but Stefano Turati is prepared and dives to thwart him.
77' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
75' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
73' 6:6 – the total goal attempt statistics. The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 3:0.
70' It's time for a substitution. Rasmus Kristensen (AS Roma) comes on in place of Rick Karsdorp.
70' Romelu Lukaku (AS Roma) bangs the ball towards goal from the edge of the box, but it's rising all the way and sails high over the bar.
69' Giuseppe Caso (Frosinone) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
68' Luca Mazzitelli (Frosinone) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Marco Brescianini.
67' Marco Brescianini (Frosinone) climbs high to connect with a cross near the penalty spot but plants a header well wide of the left post.
64' Whoa! Such gestures are commonly penalised and Rick Karsdorp (AS Roma) duly receives a yellow card.
64' Enzo Barrenechea (Frosinone) commits a nasty foul by bringing down his opponent.
63' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) volleys the ball on the edge of the box after a rebound. It's a great effort and has Stefano Turati scrambling, but it flies just over the bar.
62' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar.
61' Eusebio Di Francesco has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Giuseppe Caso (Frosinone) replacing Jaime Baez Stabile.
61' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Marvin Cuni walks off the pitch to be replaced by Walid Cheddira (Frosinone).
60' The game is interrupted now, Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
60' A pass into the box finds Edoardo Bove (AS Roma) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the bottom right corner, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Stefano Turati denies him.
58' The resulting corner from Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
57' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat. The referee signals a corner kick to AS Roma.
53' Anthony Oyono (Frosinone) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
51' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
50' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat. AS Roma force their opponents to concede a corner.
48' Matteo Marchetti has a clear sight and sees a foul from Marvin Cuni (Frosinone).
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45+1' Jaime Baez Stabile (Frosinone) is caught offside!
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
42' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) commits a rough challenge and Matteo Marchetti blows his whistle for a foul.

40' What a poor attempt! Luca Mazzitelli (Frosinone) drives another shot towards goal - this time from further out, but it couldn't have been worse if he had shot blindfolded. The ball goes yards wide of the left post.
37' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
34' Luca Mazzitelli (Frosinone) overhits the corner kick and none of his teammates can their head on it.

33' Jaime Baez Stabile (Frosinone) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the bottom left corner, but Rui Patricio easily deals with the threat. Frosinone will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
32' The ball is cleared after Marvin Cuni (Frosinone) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.

30' A sweet pass finds Romelu Lukaku (AS Roma) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the left side of the goal. Stefano Turati is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second.
29' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.
28' Caleb Okoli (Frosinone) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Rui Patricio, who smothers the ball.
26' Marvin Cuni (Frosinone) latches on to a precise cross on the edge of the box and strikes the ball goalwards. However, it whistles wide of the right post so the goalkeeper can relax.

24' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again. A free kick has been awarded to Frosinone.
23' Matteo Marchetti sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
23' The AS Roma players halt their celebrations as referee Matteo Marchetti makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.

21' 1 - 0 Goal! Paulo Dybala finds Romelu Lukaku (AS Roma) with a clever pass. He steps inside his man on the edge of the box and whips a tremendous shot into the bottom right corner. Fantasy football! 1:0.
19' Eusebio Di Francesco is forced to make a change. Simone Romagnoli (Frosinone) is unable to continue due to injury, Marco Brescianini comes on.
18' Brilliant play from Marvin Cuni (Frosinone) to get past Rui Patricio in goal, but he fails to find the net from an acute angle.

17' Rick Karsdorp (AS Roma) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Matteo Marchetti blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
12' Luca Mazzitelli (Frosinone) controls a rebound and tries to catch the keeper out from long range, but it's a poor effort that sails high over the bar.
11' Jaime Baez Stabile (Frosinone) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
11' Riccardo Marchizza (Frosinone) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared. The ball is out of play. Frosinone will have a chance to score from a corner.
8' AS Roma can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
7' AS Roma fail to score from a corner as Stefano Turati (Frosinone) leaps to collect the ball. AS Roma have a corner.

7' Leonardo Spinazzola (AS Roma) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance. The ball goes out of play. AS Roma are awarded a corner kick.
6' The resulting corner comes to nothing as Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) sends it out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Frosinone.
5' The resulting set piece from AS Roma is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players. AS Roma have been awarded a corner kick.
5' Romelu Lukaku (AS Roma) attempts to find his teammate with a short pass into the box. Paulo Dybala collects the ball, but his attack is thwarted by the defence.
3' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) tries to find Romelu Lukaku, but he puts too much power on the through ball. The ball goes out of play and Frosinone will have a goal kick.
3' Frosinone hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
1' The match has just started.
AS Roma will kick-off.
